title: The Proliferation of Illicit Drones in Southeast Asia
author: Rueben Dass
text:
A DJI FPV drone photographed at a retail electronics store in Nagoya, Japan, May 22, 2021.
Credit: Wikimedia Commons/KKPCW
Drones have become synonymous with modern-day warfare. Recent conflict theaters in Russia-Ukraine, Myanmar, Sudan, parts of the Sahel, and the Middle East have witnessed the heavy use of drones, and the Russia-Ukraine war in particular has been a crucible of innovation in this regard. Southeast Asia has not been immune to the use of drones, which have been used widely in conflicts such as the 2017 Marawi siege, the Myanmar conflict since 2021, and the Thailand-Cambodia border conflict last year.Beyond their use in conflict, the region has seen a steady increase in the illicit use of drones primarily involving commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) consumer drones (Figure 1).[...]
